rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends watch family only through the broad core/view/** selector. The Pulp-owned change makes a pointer HOVER resolve through the root's open overlay stack in the same top-down order a press already does, so an open popover that reaches outside the view it is mounted in shows its own cursor, receives the scripted pointermove, and takes the hover state, instead of the view it paints over. One new read-only verb (hover_target_at) sits beside route_press_to_active_overlay; hover_cursor_at, deliver_hover_move, View::simulate_hover and the standalone macOS host's cursor resolution call it and fall back to the unchanged tree hit test when no open overlay contains the point. A hover never dismisses. Paint, press routing, dismissal, layout, asset, renderer, canvas, Skia, Dawn, and authority behavior are unchanged, as is per-root ownership. Regressions are confined to test/test_overlay_routing.cpp. No accepted expansion boundary moves, no Vellum implementation is changed, and no generated artifact or manifest row moves. Registered watch-only so the family's coverage stays explicit about this core/view hover-routing change.
